csv_project_name: AE for ODNR Post-Construction Services Consultant
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) intends to pre-qualify firms to provide testing, investigation, analysis, and specialty services for post-construction investigations and/or remediation projects. The services will be contracted directly with ODNR or assigned as a sub-consultant to the design professional selected for the project, depending on the specific scope of services required for the project. Work assignments for post-construction investigation and/or remediation projects may include: Architecture and engineering services (any engineering discipline); Preparation of cost estimates; Quality assurance testing, observation and reporting; HVAC testing, adjusting and balancing; Enhanced commissioning services; Soil testing and engineering; Various studies, investigations, and root cause analysis: o mechanical, electrical, plumbing and technology (MEPT); o geotechnical; o Civil; o Structural; o Masonry; o Roofing and building envelope evaluation, including moisture and humidity measurement, thermal imaging, and destructive testing; o Electrical power quality analysis, including data logging of voltage fluctuations, harmonics, outages and other anomalies; o Commercial flooring, wood flooring; o Food service and kitchen equipment; o Fire suppression and alarm systems; o Environmental, including hazardous materials assessments; o Survey; o Underwater investigations; and o Interiors.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Soil Testing, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: AE for ODNR Post-Construction Services Consultant
short_description: Prequalification for post-construction building investigations, testing, analysis, and remediation support services.
project_scope: Prequalification of firms for post-construction investigations and remediation projects for the Ohio Department of Natural Resources. Potential assignments include architecture and engineering services across multiple disciplines; cost estimating; quality assurance testing, observation and reporting; HVAC testing, adjusting and balancing; enhanced commissioning; soil testing and engineering; and studies, investigations, and root cause analyses for MEPT, geotechnical, civil, structural, masonry, roofing and building envelope systems, electrical power quality, flooring, food service and kitchen equipment, fire suppression and alarm systems, environmental hazards, surveying, underwater investigations, and interiors. No specific building, span, area, or construction volume is defined.
services: On-call/post-construction consultant services including architecture, interior design, civil, geotechnical, soil testing, surveying, environmental, electrical, mechanical, and structural engineering; investigations; testing; analysis; remediation support; QA observation and reporting; commissioning-related services; and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a broad prequalification/on-call consultant procurement rather than a defined structural project.
- Focus is mainly post-construction investigations, testing, remediation, and specialty diagnostics.
- Includes many disciplines, but structural engineering is only one part of a general building services pool.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or architecturally demanding building is identified.
- The notice resembles framework-style consulting without technical definition, which is low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for prequalification of consultant services for future post-construction investigations and remediation assignments, with no defined project size, building area, or construction volume. Therefore no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The procurement is a prequalification for one or more renewable consultant contracts over a 24-month base period, but no assignment volumes, budgets, or fee schedules are provided.
references_qualifications: Firms are to be pre-qualified for post-construction investigation and remediation-related services. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, soil testing, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. Specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.

notes: Target market is General Building. County: Franklin. State: Ohio. One or more contracts may be awarded. Contract duration/base period: 24 months. Renewable: No. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Although structural investigations are included, the notice is primarily an indefinite post-construction services pool and not a clearly defined design assignment.
